name: PartyTargetWatch
release_type_reason: Version 0.3.1 has offline mock coverage only and has not been loaded and validated in game. Updating installed files and observations of historical versions do not validate this version.
icon_rights: Original vector artwork created for PartyTargetWatch, distributed under the MIT License; no third-party game, platform, or addon artwork used.
not_live_verified: Multiline declaration editor, cursor scrolling, Chinese input and literal pipe preservation
Draft sample tests, save/cancel boundaries and template persistence
Background-only opacity and transparent background behavior
Target raid markers and scene visibility
compatibility_note: Outgoing target calls, their commands, binding and dedicated diagnostics are removed in 0.3.1. Incoming public chat declarations and optional public focus addon messages remain. Declarations are assignments, not actual focus; a marker alone is not resolved to a monster name. Leaving combat does not guarantee readable NPC names, marker values or unlocked chat. Only publicly readable data may be transmitted.
upgrade_note: The release contains 7 files and no Bindings.xml. The local installer backs up the old installation before removing that retired file. For manual upgrades, back up the old addon folder outside AddOns and replace it with the complete new folder; preserve WTF SavedVariables.

checks: Changing scale from 100% to 110% and back to 100%
Updating the player's own selected-target name

background_opacity.affects: Background, border and row fills only; text and icons remain visible.
